metadata.title: python-react-template
metadata.description: A full-stack template with FastAPI and React.

hero.title: A practical FastAPI and React monorepo that runs quickly
hero.description: A development foundation that separates backend and frontend responsibilities while keeping build, delivery, planning, and quality gates in one place. It is designed to keep structure and process clear even when AI agents participate in development.
signalLines: Frontend build output goes to backend/static/
Planning workflow and quality gates defined up front

tabs.label: Page summary
tabs.overview: See what the starter structure includes.
tabs.architecture: Review the frontend, backend, and static delivery connection points.
tabs.workflow: Check the work sequence from Plan through Act.
tabs.quality: Understand the verification gates to run before and after changes.

overview.label: Overview
overview.title: What this template gives you from the start
overview.description: This page keeps the adoption-critical details short and close to implementation reality. It shows how the foundation fits together, not just which technologies are included.

cards.title: Backend
cards.description: Build FastAPI APIs and CLI tools together under backend/.

cards.title: Frontend
cards.description: Use React + Vite to build UI quickly while keeping type safety.

cards.title: Delivery flow
cards.description: Frontend builds are written to backend/static/ and served by the backend.

cards.title: Development rules
cards.description: AGENTS.md and documents/plans/ provide a planning-first workflow.

architecture.label: Architecture
architecture.title: A structure with clear responsibilities and connection points
architecture.description: The frontend, backend, and build output relationship is visible first, so it is easy to see where changes belong after adoption.
highlights: frontend/ owns the React + Vite UI implementation
backend/ owns the FastAPI API and CLI
Build output is collected in backend/static/

diagram.label: Diagram of frontend, backend, and build output relationships
diagram.outputDescription: Collects frontend assets and serves them

workflow.label: Workflow
workflow.title: How work moves through this template
workflow.description: The later sections show the development flow after adoption. Plan through Act is explicit so judgment stays consistent even when AI agents are involved.

steps.description: Write the work, impact, and order in documents/plans/ before implementation.
Keep backend and frontend responsibilities separate and implement in small units.
Run tests, lint, and builds before deciding the work is complete.
Feed learnings back into plans and guides for the next change.

quality.label: Quality
quality.title: Quality gates included from the start
quality.description: The page goes beyond an introduction and shows the checks developers run when changing the project, reducing adoption risk.

groups.title: Frontend checks
groups.summary: Run format, lint, tests, and build checks to catch UI regressions.

groups.title: Backend checks
groups.summary: Run tests plus formatter and import order checks to keep the full stack healthy.

final.title: Keep the key information easy to revisit
final.description: Primary CTAs stay as page anchors so the top page can move between architecture, workflow, and quality without adding friction.
